---
# =============================================================================
# AGENTIC STYLE — GitHub Agentic Workflows (gh-aw), NO PAT
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# This markdown file is compiled by `gh aw compile` into
# `copilot-agentic-review.lock.yml` (the file Actions actually runs).
#
# Inference is authenticated with the built-in GitHub Actions token via the
# `copilot-requests: write` permission below — no personal access token. AI
# credits are billed to the organization. Requires the org policy
# "Allow use of Copilot CLI billed to the organization" to be enabled.
#
# For the CLASSIC alternative (plain Actions + Copilot CLI + PAT), see
# `.github/workflows/copilot-cli-demo.yml`.
# =============================================================================
name: PR Review — Agentic (gh-aw, copilot-requests)

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  workflow_dispatch:

engine: copilot

# `copilot-requests: write` makes gh-aw use the built-in Actions token for
# Copilot inference (billed to the org). The other permissions are read-only;
# writes (the PR comment) are performed by the scoped safe-outputs job.
permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  copilot-requests: write

network: defaults

# The agent cannot post to GitHub directly. It proposes a single PR comment,
# which the gated safe-outputs job publishes with its own scoped permissions.
safe-outputs:
  add-comment:
    max: 1
---

# Agentic Copilot PR Review

You are reviewing the pull request that triggered this workflow. Perform a concise,
high-signal code review of the changes in this PR and post the result as a single
pull request comment.

## Instructions

1. Determine the files changed in this pull request and read the diff for each.
2. For each changed file, review:
   - Code quality, structure, and readability
   - Potential bugs, security issues, and performance problems
   - Error handling and edge cases
   - Adherence to common conventions
   - Missing tests or documentation
3. Where you recommend a concrete code change, express it as a GitHub suggested
   change using a fenced ```suggestion block so it can be applied in one click.
4. Provide specific, line-referenced feedback where applicable.

## Output

Post exactly one PR comment that:

- Begins with the heading `## 🤖 Copilot PR Analysis — Agentic (gh-aw)` so it is
  clearly distinguishable from the Classic (PAT) workflow's comment.
- Contains your review, including any ```suggestion blocks.
- Ends with a one-line note that the review was generated by GitHub Agentic
  Workflows (gh-aw) using the built-in token (no PAT).

Keep the review focused and actionable; avoid restating unchanged code.
